observations: Photo 0 shows a tall, white, freestanding air conditioning unit wrapped in plastic.
The brand 'Panasonic' is visible on a silver panel in the center of the unit.
The unit has a vented top section covered in plastic wrap and a vented lower section.
It is standing on a concrete surface next to a blue and white truck.
The unit appears to be new or recently unpacked, as it is still wrapped.
No remote, water hose, or other accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Just arrived Panasonic air conditioner with the remote, water hose
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the unit; remote and water hose are not visible. The claim cannot be confirmed from the photo alone.
Cleanliness is subjective and not fully verifiable from a single photo. Functionality cannot be tested remotely.

risks.risk: The unit may be damaged or non-functional despite appearing new.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on and operating, including cooling and fan functions.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, water hose) as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos of the remote and water hose included with the unit.

risks.risk: The unit may be a counterfeit or rebranded product.
risks.proof: Close-up of the model number and serial number, and a photo of the original packaging or invoice.

proof_requests: Photos of the remote control and water hose included with the unit.
A video showing the unit powered on and operating.
Close-up of the model number and serial number on the unit.
Photo of the original packaging or invoice if available.
response.reason: The unit is identified as a Panasonic standing air conditioner, but critical claims about accessories and functionality cannot be verified from the single photo. Hidden risks include missing parts, non-functionality, and potential counterfeiting. Proof is needed to assess the item accurately.
